title: The First Row
text: Six hulls in a line, nose to tail, all facing the same way. Our design: the petals, the drone bay, the Command Core's squat tower. Our paint, what's left of it. The stencil on the nearest reads ACCORD 11. The next one along, ACCORD 10.

lines.text: "Eleven, then ten. They're numbered down the row, and the numbers get smaller as the ash gets deeper. Nobody crashed these. Somebody parked them."

choices.label: Scan the nearest hull
choices.reply: Same alloy, same welds, same firmware rack, empty. The drone bay hatch is open. Nothing inside has been switched on in a very long time.

choices.label: Walk the row
choices.reply: The drones go along the row, hull by hull. Nobody on the channel says much.
